text:
Liam J: Anyone have the APAC service/model health dashboard shortlink? I have a customer call in 20m and only see EU/US dashboards in Grafana.
Hana K: There's a dashboard under Service Overview > APAC but it's behind perms. pinging eng-sre.
Samir P: sharing shortlink: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/abc123/apac-service-health?orgId=1 :eyes: you still might get 403 if you don't have view role.
Liam J: clicking it -> 403 Forbidden :grimacing:
Samir P: can you confirm your grafana username? I can grant view on the dash.
Liam J: liam.j@redwood.com
ops-bot: Permission change: granted VIEW on dashboard abc123 to liam.j@redwood.com by Samir P
Liam J: Got it — opens fine now, thanks! :tada:
Maya R: quick follow — does that dashboard use 'model_health_v2' metric for the health panel or the legacy 'model_health'? Need to quote in the call.
Samir P: it's using model_health_v2 for APAC (query: metric=measures.model_health_v2{region="apac"}). Note there was a telemetry gap around 03:00 UTC earlier today.
Maya R: can we tone down the alert? it's spamming pager for small dips.
eng-sre-oncall: We can adjust alert window from 5m->15m and raise threshold from 10%->15% to cut noise. Will open a ticket and schedule a canary.
Samir P: created INT ticket INT-487 and linked dash + alert rule. Short excerpt:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $GRAFANA_TOKEN" "https://grafana.redwood.company/api/dashboards/uid/abc123" 
```
Samir P: tagging @eng-sre-oncall for review of alert tuning. If anyone needs the raw panel JSON ping me and I'll export.
Liam J: appreciate it, team. I'll use the dash in the call.
Hana K: added the shortlink to the customer call notes: https://grafana.redwood.company/d/abc123
Samir P: FYI I'll follow up with a PR to adjust alert thresholds and add a note in the runbook.
eng-sre-oncall: thanks all, will monitor for any regressions. :memo:
